old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a pot filled with ice cubes placed on a stovetop. The pot is metallic and sits on one of the burners, which is part of a stainless steel stovetop with black grates. The ice cubes are clear and transparent, with some showing signs of melting, as evidenced by the slight discoloration around them. The surrounding area includes parts of the kitchen countertop and floor, which appear to be made of granite and tiled respectively. The lighting is bright, highlighting the details of the ice cubes and the pot's surface. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the pot and its contents throughout the video. The camera angle is steady, providing a clear and consistent view of the pot and the stovetop.

caption: The video captures a stainless steel saucepan resting on a gas stovetop, viewed from a fixed high angle, its long handle angled toward the upper right corner. The pan is filled with clear water in which numerous ice cubes of varying sizes float clustered across the surface. Black grate bars frame the pan on either side, a speckled granite counter edge appears at the left, and white control knobs sit at the lower right, all remaining stationary throughout. The overall arrangement of the ice and water stays essentially unchanged, with no cube visibly translating, rotating, or rearranging. No boiling or bubbling is apparent, and the water surface and ice edges look calm. A small circular highlight on the right side of the ice cluster becomes noticeable partway through the excerpt and then persists, while the surrounding ice holds its position. The framing and lighting remain constant from the first frame to the last.
